gt_source: Kubernetes manifests (deployment/kubernetes/** and */src/deployment/kubernetes/*.yml) reconciled with docker-compose*.yml, each service's application.properties, build.gradle and Spring @Import/messaging configuration, the API gateway route/proxy classes, the order-history DynamoDB config, the dynamodblocal-init scripts and the GraphQL gateway server.ts.

edges.mechanism: Java Spring Cloud Gateway routes POST/PUT /orders(/**) to order.destinations.orderServiceUrl, plus WebClient GET {orderServiceUrl}/orders/{id} in OrderServiceProxy; URL from env ORDER_DESTINATIONS_ORDERSERVICEURL=http://ftgo-order-service:8080
Java Spring Cloud Gateway route GET /orders to order.destinations.orderHistoryServiceUrl; env ORDER_DESTINATIONS_ORDERHISTORYSERVICEURL=http://ftgo-order-history-service:8080
Java Spring Cloud Gateway routes POST/PUT /consumers to consumer.destinations.consumerServiceUrl; env CONSUMER_DESTINATIONS_CONSUMERSERVICEURL=http://ftgo-consumer-service:8080

Java Spring Boot JPA/JDBC datasource (also Eventuate Tram outbox/message tables); SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL=jdbc:mysql://ftgo-mysql/... in k8s manifest (application.properties default ${DOCKER_HOST_IP:localhost})
Eventuate Tram TramJdbcKafkaConfiguration (saga orchestrator: sends commands / receives replies and publishes order events); EVENTUATELOCAL_KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS=ftgo-kafka:9092

EVENTUATELOCAL_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECTION_STRING=ftgo-zookeeper:2181 is set in the manifest and application.properties, but no service code reads it and the Eventuate Tram/Kafka client libraries used (platform 2022.0) are not shown to use ZooKeeper; leader election is the CDC's job

EVENTUATELOCAL_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECTION_STRING=ftgo-zookeeper:2181 is set in the manifest and application.properties, but no service code reads it and the Eventuate Tram/Kafka client libraries used (platform 2022.0) are not shown to use ZooKeeper; leader election is the CDC's job
Eventuate Tram Kafka consumer (EventuateTramKafkaMessageConsumerConfiguration, DomainEventDispatcher for order/delivery events); EVENTUATELOCAL_KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS=ftgo-kafka:9092
EVENTUATELOCAL_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECTION_STRING set but not read by service code; library use unproven
AWS SDK AmazonDynamoDBClientBuilder with endpoint from aws.dynamodb.endpoint.url; env AWS_DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT_URL=http://ftgo-dynamodb-local:8000
Eventuate CDC (third-party image) mysql-binlog reader; EVENTUATE_CDC_READER_READER1_DATASOURCEURL=jdbc:mysql://ftgo-mysql:3306/eventuate
Eventuate CDC publishes outbox/event rows to Kafka; EVENTUATELOCAL_KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS=ftgo-kafka:29092 (port mismatch with the 9092 Service in the manifest, but the host is ftgo-kafka)
Eventuate CDC leader election (LEADERSHIPLOCKPATH) via ZooKeeper; EVENTUATELOCAL_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECTION_STRING=ftgo-zookeeper:2181
confluentinc/cp-kafka broker KAFKA_ZOOKEEPER_CONNECT=ftgo-zookeeper:2181
k8s Job (msapatterns/dynamodblocal-init): aws CLI create-table --endpoint-url $AWS_DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT_URL=http://ftgo-dynamodb-local:8000
Java Spring Boot JPA datasource; only deployed by docker-compose (SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL=jdbc:mysql://mysql/ftgo_delivery_service); no k8s manifest exists
Eventuate Tram TramJdbcKafkaConfiguration + DomainEventDispatcher (subscribes to kitchen/order events); compose-only (kafka:29092)
